verdict.rationale: Ramp exposes a documented Developer API with OpenAPI spec, an official MCP server, and CLI, showing substantial API surface area, but there is no evidence confirming full feature parity between the API and every UI capability (e.g., AI-powered intake, hotel rebooking, receipt AI-fill are described as UI/product features with no confirmation they're API-accessible). missing for 10: explicit documentation or independent confirmation that all UI actions (approvals, AI-driven workflows, card issuance nuances) are fully replicable via API, and any community/developer testimony validating full parity.
